runners.title: Standard
runners.summary: llama.cpp for AMD GPUs, ROCm or Vulkan, built from the official upstream release.
runners.maintainer_notes: Pristine ggml-org llama.cpp release, one patch (grammar repetition threshold). Gate: runners/standard/manifest.toml [verification]. The b11510 build of this recipe (as runners/upstream, PR #14) passed the gate on both lanes; b11552 needs a fresh gate. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is not gated and ships unsupported.

runners.title: CPU
runners.summary: llama.cpp on the processor, no GPU needed. A slow fallback for boxes without a supported GPU.
runners.maintainer_notes: Same llama.cpp release as standard, CPU-only, all x86_64 CPU variants as loadable backends (portable; no SIGILL on hosts without AVX-512, hal0 #2126).

runners.title: NPU (FastFlowLM)
runners.summary: Runs supported models on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU, leaving the GPU free.
runners.maintainer_notes: FastFlowLM v0.9.44 with XRT/xdna-driver 2.21.75. Needs the amdxdna driver and /dev/accel on the host.

runners.title: Kokoro speech
runners.summary: Text-to-speech on the CPU. Works on any box, no GPU needed.
runners.maintainer_notes: Kokoro-82M via kokoro-onnx 0.4.9; requirements.txt pins the full dependency set of the previously shipped image.

runners.title: Moonshine transcription
runners.summary: Speech-to-text on the CPU. Works on any box, no GPU or NPU needed.
runners.maintainer_notes: Moonshine via useful-moonshine-onnx 20251121; requirements.txt pins the full dependency set of the previously shipped image.

runners.title: ComfyUI
runners.summary: Image and video generation on the GPU (ROCm).
runners.maintainer_notes: ComfyUI c9602625 (reports 0.28.0) with TheRock nightly torch 2.9.1 for gfx1151; constraints.txt pins every package of the previously shipped image.

runners.title: Qwen3 TTS
runners.summary: Higher-quality multilingual text-to-speech on the GPU (ROCm). Opt-in; a large download (about 10 GB).
runners.maintainer_notes: qwen-tts 0.1.1 on rocm/pytorch (ROCm 7.2.4, PyTorch 2.10), base pinned by digest.

runners.title: NVIDIA CUDA
runners.summary: llama.cpp for NVIDIA GPUs. Pick it on a box with an NVIDIA card.
runners.maintainer_notes: External: ggml-org's official CUDA server image, not built here. ggml-org does not publish a server-cuda image for every llama.cpp release, so cuda pins the newest server-cuda-b<N> tag with N <= the release in runners/llama.cpp.toml (b11541 for b11552). Not hardware-gated (lanes_gated stays []): the CUDA lane is hidden in hal0 (hal0 #2362).
